questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Trichostrongylus spp.?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Cleavage-stage eggs in stool. Concentration and calibrated wet mounts at 100–400×; larval or molecular work may be needed for confirmation.
